#!/bin/sh
# .husky/pre-commit

echo "🔍 Running Cardbey Truth Enforcer..."

# Run the truth enforcer
node ../../../scripts/truth-enforcer/index.mjs

# Capture exit code
TRUTH_EXIT=$?

if [ $TRUTH_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "❌ Truth violations detected. Commit blocked."
    echo ""
    echo "To auto-fix issues:"
    echo "  npm run truth:fix"
    echo ""
    echo "To bypass (not recommended):"
    echo "  git commit --no-verify"
    exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Truth check passed. Committing..."
exit 0
